summary: Noah Holdings Limited furnished a Form 6-K containing an interim results announcement for the six months ended June 30, 2026, filed with the Hong Kong Stock Exchange as inside information. The filing reports business highlights and financial results under U.S. GAAP, discussing macroeconomic conditions, client demand shifts, and segment performance. It is a routine periodic earnings disclosure, not a special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. No deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes are involved. The filing is standard reporting, so no special-situations classification applies.
